AVX512 BLAKE3 compression for 16 lanes, with LtHash and fast-path support.

# Purpose
This C file implements AVX-512 accelerated BLAKE3 compression for up to 16 input lanes at the same time. The main function, [`fd_blake3_avx512_compress16`](<#fd_blake3_avx512_compress16>), accepts a batch of message buffers, sizes, counters, flags, and output locations, then processes each message with the BLAKE3 compression round logic in vector form. It handles normal hashing and LtHash mode, builds tail blocks for messages that do not end on a 64-byte boundary, applies the BLAKE3 round schedule through [`round_fn16`](<#round_fn16>), and stores either 32-byte chaining values or 64-byte output blocks. The file also supports an optional custom chaining value input through `batch_cv`.

The file also defines [`fd_blake3_avx512_compress16_fast`](<#fd_blake3_avx512_compress16_fast>), which is a fixed-shape fast path for hashing 16 equal-sized blocks with known layout. It loads 16 message lanes directly, transposes them into vector form, runs the same BLAKE3 round function, and writes the results to the output buffer. The code uses helper types and functions from the `fd_blake3_private.h` and SIMD utility headers, and it is intended as an internal implementation file for BLAKE3 hashing on AVX-512 capable systems.
